p.em: Who uses the system and what external systems does it talk to?

g.title: Airline counter staff who create and manage bookings on behalf of walk-in passengers
Staff at the departure gate who manage boarding and manifest
Operations manager with full system access — flight config, reports, user management
Traveller whose data is managed through the system (indirect user)
Internal airline operations platform — booking management, check-in, boarding, payments, flight ops view
Thai payment gateway — credit/debit card processing and PromptPay QR generation
Thai interbank payment network — real-time QR payment confirmation via Omise webhook
SendGrid (email) + Twilio / True Move H (SMS) — e-tickets, boarding passes, delay alerts
